entities.name: UniProt A4D126
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed human UniProt A4D126; protein is D-ribitol-5-phosphate cytidylyltransferase (ISPD).
Catalyzes CDP-ribitol formation from D-ribitol-5-phosphate and CTP; CDP-ribitol supports phosphorylated O-mannosyl glycan synthesis on alpha-dystroglycan.
Reviewed annotations place the enzyme in cytosol/cytoplasm and associate it with protein O-linked mannosylation and protein glycosylation.
Sequence Pfam hits: IspD (PF01128), NTP_transf_3 (PF12804), and ISPD_C (PF18706).

entities.name: O-mannosylation
observations: ISPD produces CDP-ribitol used by FKTN during biosynthesis of the phosphorylated O-mannosyl glycan on alpha-dystroglycan.

entities.name: Cytosol
observations: Reviewed human UniProt A4D126 annotation reports cytosol/cytoplasm localization; GO cellular component includes cytosol (GO:0005829).
